origin.description: Map each string to lower case with ICU.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale, or one locale id such as tr_TR.

origin.details: Vectorized over str. The mapping can change the number of code points, and it depends on the locale and on surrounding characters. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
origin.example:
x <- stri_trans_tolower("I", "tr_TR")
cat(paste0('stri_trans_tolower("I", "tr_TR") returns U+', sprintf("%04X", utf8ToInt(x)), '.\n'))

translation.description: Map each string to lower case with ICU.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: NULL or "" for the default locale, or one locale id such as tr_TR.

translation.details: ICU UnicodeString.toLower does the mapping. locale None or an empty string uses the default locale. Turkish tr_TR maps I to dotless i (U+0131). Lithuanian maps I plus a combining dot to i plus two combining dots. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.trans import stri_trans_tolower
x = stri_trans_tolower("I", "tr_TR")
print(f'stri_trans_tolower("I", "tr_TR") returns U+{ord(x):04X}.')
